newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel EPS lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel EPS lowered.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said in a report released on Tuesday it was lowering its fourth-quarter 1996 earnings estimates for Tadiran Telecommunications, citing higher-than-expected operating expenses.

Analyst Tim Luke said he was now forecasting earnings of $0.13 a share for the quarter, down from an earlier estimate of $0.18. As a result, full-year earnings will be $1.75 a share, rather than $1.80.
Tadiran Telecommunications, a subsidiairy of Tadiran Ltd, is due to report fourth-quarter results tomorrow.

Luke said the company was likely to report higher revenues in the quarter than originally forecast as strong export sales offset declining revenues at home. He said the trend would continue in 1997 and said he was holding to 1997 earnings per share of $1.75.
"Our 2/Outperform rating and price target of $26 is based on the company achieving a multiple of 15 times our 1997 earnings estimate of $1.75," Luke said.
